formulas.median: statistics.median(result.wall_seconds), all attempted posts including failures
formulas.sum_item_wall: sum(result.wall_seconds); distinct from elapsed batch wall time

projection.limitation: Median-based arithmetic illustration, not measured throughput. No same-model parallel post batch was recorded; do not divide by worker count.

news.scope: Observed envelope of three provider comparison workers, including agent/post/media; not throughput of one model on 1,000 distinct posts.

threads.scope: Observed envelope of three provider comparison workers, including agent/post/media; not throughput of one model on 1,000 distinct posts.

eval_v2.limitation: The manifest wall_clock_s is a resumed invocation, not the complete result envelope. Neither is a measured 1,000-post batch. Do not derive parallel post throughput from it.

narration_sentence: On saved Threads posts, the median was 6.8 seconds: a thousand posts would take about 1.9 hours sequentially at that median.
limits: Saved paraphrased inputs; shared preseeded SEC cache; startup, transport, tools and failures included.
Provider workers and validation overlapped. Timing is not an isolated API benchmark.
Coverage is not accuracy; text timings do not measure OCR/ASR or full article recall.
